answer: Filling 113 aliases thus needs 113 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. Because the mirror index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the garden audit republishes the digest set at close. Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a forge index of commitments rather than against the text alone. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
